core.mcp.title: MCP server
core.mcp.intro: AI agents (Claude Code, Claude Desktop or any MCP client) can read the state of DevDock and start npm scripts. The server only answers on this computer and requires the token.
core.mcp.tokenHint: The token is stored next to config.json (.devdock-mcp-token) and is not exported. Regenerating it disconnects the clients configured with the old one.
core.mcp.claudeDesktopHint: In claude_desktop_config.json: DevDock's stdio bridge reads the token by itself, so the configuration holds no secret and keeps working if you regenerate the token. If you update Node.js or move DevDock, copy this configuration again.
core.mcp.otherClients: Other clients: Streamable HTTP transport to the endpoint above, with the header Authorization: Bearer <token>.
core.mcp.toolsHint: Database tools only work while the vault is unlocked from this UI: the agent never receives nor enters the master password.
core.mcp.confirmRegenerate: Regenerate the token? Clients configured with the current one will stop working.
core.mcp.regenerated: Token regenerated: update the clients' configuration

core.ext.title: Extensions
core.ext.movedTitle: The tag of the installed version now points to another commit of the repository
core.ext.pendingHint: Extensions in the list imported from another DevDock installation: each one shows its preview before it is installed.
core.ext.noneInstalled: No installed extensions: look for them in the catalog or install them from a git URL.
core.ext.builtinHint: They are updated with DevDock ({version}); they can be switched off but not removed.
core.ext.catalogEmpty: No extensions in the configured catalogs.
core.ext.urlHint: Any git repository: GitHub, GitLab, a company server or a local folder. Private repositories use your own git credentials (SSH keys or credential helper). Versions are semver tags (v1.2.0, or <code>@1.2.0 for an extension in a folder).
core.ext.folderHint: Empty when the extension is at the root; it can also be written in the URL as #path=folder.
core.ext.catalogsHint: One URL per line of a JSON file listing extensions (code, name, description, repository and folder). The official devdock-extensions catalog is the default; an empty list uses no catalog.
core.ext.noTags: The repository has no version tags: the default branch is installed ({version}).
core.ext.incompatible: Requires DevDock {range}, this is {version}: pick another version.
core.ext.npmHint: npm dependencies are installed without running scripts.
core.ext.restartHint: This extension can't be hot-loaded: DevDock must be restarted after the install.
core.ext.security: An extension runs with all the rights of your user (files, commands, network): install only from sources you trust.
core.ext.steps.copy: Files copied into the extensions folder
core.ext.restartNeeded: Installed: restart DevDock to use it
core.ext.confirmRemove: Remove {name}? Its data in config.json stay: reinstalling it brings everything back.
